description: Premium animated wedding e-invitations crafted with love. From grand royal themes to soft floral designs — each invite features animations, music, event schedules, and a personalized touch.

templates.name: Anjali & Maneet Grand Invite
templates.description: A grand multi-page animated wedding e-invite for Anjali & Maneet. Featuring envelope reveal animation, ceremony itinerary, animated Ganesh blessing, photo gallery, and traditional music. Rich maroon-gold palette with hand-crafted floral motifs throughout.
templates.imageAlt: Anjali & Maneet grand luxurious animated wedding invitation

templates.name: Golden Door Reveal
templates.description: A breathtaking animated wedding e-invite where two ornate golden temple doors swing open dramatically to unveil the invitation inside. Deep navy and gold palette with filigree patterns and ambient bokeh lighting creates a cinematic, unforgettable reveal.
templates.imageAlt: Golden Door animated wedding invitation — ornate doors opening
highlights: Deep navy and gold color theme

templates.name: Royal Grand Invite
templates.description: The flagship Royal Grand Invite — a fully interactive animated wedding e-invite. Features peacock motif splash screen, envelope opening reveal, multi-page event schedule (Mehendi, Sangeet, Wedding, Reception), photo gallery, animated countdown timer, and embedded background music. The gold-emerald palette evokes true royal opulence.
templates.imageAlt: Royal Grand interactive animated wedding e-invite with peacock motif

templates.name: Floral Bloom
templates.description: A beautifully crafted floral wedding e-invite bathed in soft blush pinks and rose golds. Watercolor-style floral borders of peonies, roses, and jasmine frame the invitation with a delicate, romantic touch. Perfect for couples who love a soft, dreamy aesthetic. Features envelope animation, event itinerary, and a photo gallery.
templates.imageAlt: Floral Bloom romantic blush pink wedding invitation
highlights: Soft blush pink and rose gold palette

templates.name: Curtain Reveal
templates.description: A show-stopping wedding e-invite where rich crimson velvet curtains dramatically part at center stage to reveal the invitation. Golden rope tassels, warm spotlight, and rose petals falling complete the theatrical atmosphere. One of our most visually impactful designs — guaranteed to impress guests.
templates.imageAlt: Curtain Reveal dramatic crimson velvet wedding e-invite

templates.name: Silk Drape
templates.description: An ethereal and dreamy wedding e-invite featuring sheer lavender silk curtains that gently part to unveil the invitation in soft, floating motion. Fairy lights glow through the translucent fabric as flower petals drift down. The pastel purple-lavender palette creates a magical, storybook atmosphere perfect for modern romantic weddings.
templates.imageAlt: Silk Drape lavender sheer curtain wedding e-invite
